'''Grenkk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Krex (species)|Krex]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] who worked at [[Club Vertica Casino]] as a [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] during a [[Soovada]] event.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grenkk appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the Nightlife event.
